body:
Under the inherited analytic and fixed finite-alphabet multitape hypotheses,

$$T(n)=O(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}),\qquad\kappa=\frac{4123863984}{10^{14}}=4.123863984\times10^{-5}>2^{-15}.$$

This is **0.12719% above PR #48** (`411862541/10^13`). The bit saving is `4124034054/10^14`.

**Full `make verify` PASSED** at research commit `9c9c198656c5b926de951292c111e81ccf191634`: **192 tests**, five new focused tests, fresh changed-producer/profile and full physical dirty-basis replay, inherited data geometry with exact fallback recovery, and **18 historical patch checks**. Completed 2026-10-08T15:44:38.918471+00:00 in 442.2 seconds. [Validation receipt](https://github.com/rohanarun/integer-mult-bounds/blob/research/climbed-48/research/climbed-48/validation.json); full log SHA256 `f302a33b7f5660e54741fcc0454fca065754f191045caa7e689779bda5a74e90`. Follow-up changes are documentation and receipt metadata only.

## Construction

PR #48 reordered the leave-one-out `vector()` sums. PR #47 explored climbing summand orders. Starting from #48's orders, this construction pins adjacent-swap bits for both `total()` calls (`tbits`) and `vector()` calls (`vbits`), combining those search directions. The supplied cloud checks report that zero swap bits reproduce #48's DAGs byte-for-byte.

| Quantity | PR #48 | This PR |
|---|---:|---:|
| h23 roles R | 36,432 | **36,382** (6,077 matched; 14+10 swaps) |
| h25 roles R | 48,329 | **48,255** (7,809 matched; 10+13 swaps) |
| Width W | 177,530,859 | **177,284,805** |

All other components are inherited from #48: RaD's point order, original-envelope labels, both fixed I+J bases, copied centers, paid endpoint corrections, reversed data corners with exact recovery of all ten fallbacks, the complex layer and balanced assembly.

**Search scope:** the optimizer uses floating-point logarithmic weights and SciPy assignment. It proposes finite pinned carrier-use lists, whose legality, profiles and exact arithmetic witness are checked independently. No exact weighted-matching optimality, global optimality, or measured runtime improvement is claimed. The README now states this distinction explicitly.

## Verification

At source commit `9c9c198656c5b926de951292c111e81ccf191634`, `make climbed-48-verify` independently replays:

- Both changed scalar graphs, dense support audits, pinned matching admissibility and independent recounts.
- Complete physical timelines and every dirty basis vector in both orientations; zero CRT disagreements.
- The exact moment, all 47 strict constraints and seven margins; next bit-saving and kappa grid points rejected.
- Exact lower-moment exclusions for the retained PR #40–#48 comparison networks.
- Five focused tests, including frozen certificate equality and injective matching controls.

The handoff also reports reproduction of #48's certificate and the zero-swap DAG identities in its cloud environment. Full repository verification has now passed as recorded above. Finite checks do not establish the inherited general transfer and analytic interfaces; those still require mathematical review.

title: Climbed orders on reordered exclusion sums for a conditional κ = 4.123863984e-5 bound
